question_or_proposition: Does the nominated passage impose an obligation to conduct Delta-BHC testing or sampling at the source water intake during the relevant period, or solely an obligation to submit a detailed study plan describing proposed testing for EPA and NMED approval?
required_context: Federal FY2025 date range (2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30 inclusive)
Permit effective date relative to the six-month plan-submission deadline
Adjacent Delta-BHC Study provisions in Part I.B establishing post-approval quarterly sampling in permit years 2–5
notes: The nominated clause sits under Schedule of Compliance (Delta-BHC Study), not Part I.A effluent numeric limits. Interpretation of whether 'submit a detailed plan to test' creates only a plan-submission duty or also an immediate intake-testing/monitoring duty would change which monitoring obligations are deemed applicable (Purpose B) and how missing Delta-BHC-related evidence is classified when no ordinary numeric result is present (Purpose C).
